title: Lean proof — Ryser bounded n less equal 63 per D3 sketch
description:
Implement the Lean4 proof of Ryser's permanent formula correctness on the project's `FiniteField` trait, scoped to bounded $n \le 63$, per the approved D3 proof sketch.

## Background

D3's approved proof sketch (`4aaa6e4d`) bounds $n \le 63$ to fit within the single-`u64` subset enumeration regime; this avoids formalising arbitrary-arity sums (per the epic non-goal). The proof shows the in-tree `permanent_ryser<F>` matches the standard Ryser permanent definition, with the Gray-code walk preserving the running column-sum invariant.

Same pipeline as V1; same verification-work conventions. **Implementation now follows the lead-approved Option 2 (see Amendments): the lead-approved Path-1 sketch `dev/plans/d3_v2_path1_sketch.md` applies for the transparent-gfp pipeline (§3) and the L4–L9 + headline lemmas (§4/§5), but the proof target is the committed iterator-free monomorphic `ryser_fp3.rs` body — NOT the §2 option-(b) thin delegation, which the gated extraction spike empirically falsified.**

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `proofs/Gf2Algebra/Proofs/RyserBounded.lean` exists with the bounded-$n$ Ryser correctness theorem and the Gray-code-walk loop invariant.
- [ ] [hard] `cd proofs && lake build` succeeds with no `sorry` in the new file.
- [ ] [hard] The proof targets the F_3 monomorphisation `gf2_algebra::permanent::ryser_fp3::permanent_ryser_fp3` (the committed iterator-free body), which is test-certified bit-identical to the generic production `permanent_ryser::<Fp<3>>` (T7) via the `ryser_fp3.rs` cross-check tests (250 random cases, n ≤ 5, plus n = 8 path coverage). It is a thin monomorphisation target, not an independent re-derivation of the algorithm. (Amended 2026-05-17 from "targets the Rust production `permanent_ryser` (T7) generic over `FiniteField`, not a copied stub"; see Amendments §1.)
- [ ] [hard] Bound $n \le 63$ is explicit in the theorem statement.
- [ ] [hard] `scripts/verify-lean.sh` regenerates LLBC + Lean from current Rust successfully.
- [ ] [hard] `lake-build` gate passes.

## Amendments (2026-05-17, user-approved via project-lead escalation)

1. **Criterion 3 reworded.** From "The proof targets the Rust production `permanent_ryser` (T7) generic over `FiniteField`, not a copied stub" → "The proof targets the F_3 monomorphisation `permanent_ryser_fp3` (committed iterator-free body), test-certified bit-identical to the generic `permanent_ryser::<Fp<3>>` (T7)". **Reason:** the lead-approved Path-1 sketch's §2 option-(b) (replace `ryser_fp3.rs` with a thin delegation so Charon monomorphises the generic) was **empirically falsified** by the gated extraction spike (2026-05-17, evidence in `dev/active/0606186a-impl-handoff.md`): on the pinned Charon `1ec8d4bb` + 4 local patches, a non-generic `--start-from` root does **not** monomorphise the generic `permanent_ryser<F>` — Charon extracts it fully generic and Aeneas emits literal `sorry` into the proof target's own def signature (`Could not find: type_var_id 1/2 from ExtractBase.Item`, `ryser.rs:152-163`). Direct generic extraction is infeasible on the pinned toolchain. The committed monomorphic `ryser_fp3.rs` is iterator-free by design and extracts cleanly; its `test_permanent_ryser_fp3_matches_generic_small` (250 random cases × n ≤ 5, plus n = 8) certifies bit-identity to the generic T7. The transparent-gfp half of Path 1 (spike-proven to work — Charon extracted gfp transparently with a 6.96 MB LLBC) is retained; only the generic-delegation half is dropped. Selected by the user as Option 2 over (1) a 5th shared-infra Charon patch, (3) an unproven closure-helper SSOT, and (4) de-scoping to the abstract side.
